verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator, not a service with production data and a separate test environment, so a sandbox-versus-production story does not fit this kind of product. GPU partitioning, SR-IOV and virtualization tooling provide hardware workload isolation, but that is a different capability. Nothing in the evidence shows AMD offering a sandbox or test environment kept apart from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
